title: Run OSS application with PulseAudio
summary: Use the padsp wrapper to run applications that only support OSS (Open Sound System) so they output audio through PulseAudio.

steps.explain: Prefix the command to run the OSS application with 'padsp'. Replace <OSS_PROGRAM> with the name of the program.

placeholders.name: OSS_PROGRAM
placeholders.description: The command to run the OSS-only application.
